تستبدلوا (form X)
# تَسْتَبْدِلُوا (tastabdilū) /tas.tab.di.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَبْدَلَ (istabdala)
# تُسْتَبْدَلُوا (tustabdalū) /tus.tab.da.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَبْدَلَ (istabdala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
